correctness.rationale: The published equivalent formula for \(DW_I(X)\) was reconstructed from both directions of the normalization argument. For arbitrary unit \(x,y\), the proof sets \(a=\|x+y\|\), \(b=\|x-y\|\), assumes \(a\ge b\) by symmetry, applies the triangle inequality to \(b(x+y)-a(x-y)\), then uses \(a\le2\). The resulting scalar envelope is exactly \(2+t-t^2=9/4-(t-1/2)^2\). The \(\ell_\infty^2\) witness gives equality exactly. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
